findings.issue: תּוֹרֹתָיו is a common noun (feminine plural + 3ms suffix: his instructions/laws). “torás” leaves the lemma untranslated as a Hebraized loanword.
בָּא is qal perfect 3ms; “viene” is present and does not carry the perfect.
Imperfect יִהְיֶה is future “será”, while the sequential perfects that continue it are present “juzgo” and “hago conocer”, so the Spanish splits one Hebrew time-frame.

notes: Dios, the hiphil causative, both entre, and the 3mp/1cs participants match the tokens.
